# Elan

> Elan is an alpha, graph-native Python orchestrator for explicit AI-written
> dynamic workflows. Its product direction is AI-writable, human-reviewable,
> machine-validatable orchestration.

Use the capability status before relying on a feature. “Native to the model” is
separate from Available, Experimental, Planned, or Direction.

## Primary documentation

- [Capability status](https://accelerate-lux.github.io/elan/status/): canonical maturity ledger
- [AI authoring](https://accelerate-lux.github.io/elan/learn/ai-authoring/): current patterns, anti-patterns, and agent instructions
- [API overview](https://accelerate-lux.github.io/elan/reference/api/): handwritten public API contract
- [Runtime behavior](https://accelerate-lux.github.io/elan/reference/runtime-behavior/): exact execution semantics
- [Python API](https://accelerate-lux.github.io/elan/reference/python-api/): generated object reference
